issue.description: The R3A feature-construction report carried the git blob SHA-1 of a historical data-preflight JSON file as though that generated report were a stable source file. Each new preflight report also contains merged_gzip_sha256, which can change with gzip-container metadata while the canonical uncompressed CSV SHA-256 remains identical.

correction.feature_report_source_pins: Do not require a static blob pin for a generated run-specific preflight JSON; continue validating static source pins and the preregistered feature contract.
correction.preflight_verification: Validate canonical decoded CSV hash, artifact ID/run lineage, global-blocker status, frozen 75/5 eligible/blocked cell accounting, no fitting/holdout flags, exact preprocessing/preregistration/calendar content hashes, and frozen paths.
correction.execution_gate: Record both Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 of the exact run-specific preflight report. The empirical runner must compare the supplied report path and bytes against these run-scoped pins before fitting.
correction.preflight_report_builder: Retain the true preregistration Git blob SHA-1; do not overwrite it with null in report.update.

regression_tests: Fresh run-specific preflight with current canonical and source hashes is accepted.
Wrong canonical hash, preprocessing hash, preregistration hash, or pinned source artifact ID is rejected.
A stale historical preflight-report blob in the feature report does not override a fresh semantically valid report.
developer_to_tester: After complete results are acquired and frozen, independently verify current run-specific preflight hashes, all 320 config/fold terminal rows, feature timing, purge/embargo, model metrics, bootstrap numerical reproducibility, BY multiplicity, and all blocked or failed outcomes.
